Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.300 of 2022 at Police Station-Phase-II Central Commissionarate, District-Gautam Budh Nagar under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 304B, 201 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text: Police Station-Phase-II Central Commissionarate, District-Gautam Budh Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 22.09.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 03.02.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Rakesh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Chandan Agrawal, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:

sentences.text: 1. The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
2. The applicant had a harmonious domestic life and deep affection for his wife.
3. The applicant did not torture the deceased nor did he demand dowry.
The applicant is bereaved by the death of his wife.
4. The deceased was suffering from chronic ailments.
She became depressed when her condition did not improve despite prolonged medical care.
5. On the fateful day, the deceased succumbed to depression and took the extreme step of ending her life.
She committed suicide by hanging.
6. The postmortem report available with the learned AGA opines the cause of death as asphyxia due to antemortem hanging.

7. Injuries depicted in the postmortem report consistent with hanging are:
(i) Nature of ligature mark.
(ii). The hyoid bone was intact.
8. The applicant did not aid or abet the suicide.
9. Prosecution evidence do not connect the applicant with the offence.
10. The prerequisite for attracting the presumption and the reversing the burden of proof are not established in the facts and circumstances and evidence of the case.
11. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
12.
The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of their influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Mehraj be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.
The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
Mehraj vs State Of U.P. on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60594827/
2 (ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
